name: glow
description: Animated light around one box: a rotating gradient ring or a single orbiting beam, with an optional blurred halo behind the child. The ring is drawn outside the wrapped element by a masked pseudo-element, so the child keeps its own background and border. Pure CSS (a registered angle property drives the orbit); always on, or only under the pointer and keyboard.

halo.description: Add the blurred copy of the ring behind the child — the light the ring casts. The child needs an opaque background for the halo to read as a glow around it rather than through it.

static.description: Stop the orbit and keep the gradient border.

--glow-radius.description: Corner radius of the wrapped child (custom property). Must match the child: var(--button-radius) around a button, var(--radius-full) around an avatar.

--glow-width.description: Thickness of the ring (custom property). Pass a border-width token.

--glow-color-1.description: First colour of the ring (custom property).

--glow-color-2.description: Second colour of the ring (custom property).

--glow-blur.description: With data-halo: how far the halo spreads (custom property).

--glow-opacity.description: With data-halo: strength of the halo, 0–1 (custom property).

--glow-duration.description: The ambient duration the orbit is cut from (custom property): one turn takes a quarter of it.

a11y.notes: Decoration only: no role, no accessible name, no focus stop, and the ring ignores pointer events. data-trigger="hover" also lights on :focus-within, so keyboard users get the same cue. The orbit stops under prefers-reduced-motion (the border stays); forced colours and print drop it.

notes: One child. The root is a one-cell grid, so the child fills it; a second child would sit in a second row inside the same ring.
The ring sits outside the child by --glow-width, so leave that much room in a tight grid, or the neighbours' gap absorbs it.
Use a <span data-ui="glow"> around inline-level things (a button in a row of buttons) and a <div> around blocks.
The featured tier of a pricing table, the primary call to action, one card in a bento: a glow marks the ONE thing on the screen that matters most. Two of them cancel out.
